capabilities: Run Tabula transformation scripts on csv, table, and include code blocks in Markdown files
Auto-execute transformations when a file is saved
Execute Tabula manually via command palette commands
Toggle auto-execution and column/row name visibility
Configure the Tabula executable path and output auto-formatting
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table editor; it executes an external Tabula CLI script against CSV code blocks and writes the transformed output back.
extras: Requires installing the separate Tabula CLI and making it accessible in PATH or via a configured path; complete Tabula documentation lives on the external Tabula website, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute over or transform CSV data embedded in notes; edits to CSV blocks stay static without an external transformation step.

relations.evidence: Obsidian plugin for Tabula - a spreadsheet-inspired CSV transformation tool.

summary: Wrapper for the Tabula CLI that transforms CSV code blocks in Markdown files using spreadsheet-style formulas, running on save or on demand.
